body.label: Effect
body.html: Move up to 3 units. This movement may include climbing or leaping and ignores difficult terrain.

surges.html: Increase your Movement by 2 until the end of your next turn.
Until your next turn, enemies within 2 units cannot gain a benefit from being hidden from you.

rider.title: STRIDER ADAPTATION
rider.html: Before resolving this Action, you may assume Raptor Form. While maintained: The first 2 units you move each turn ignore difficult terrain.
